date.as_written: śake 1767 vaiśāṣe māsi aṣṭamyāṃ tithau śravaṇanakṣatre śubhe yoge bhaumāvāre

place.as_written: garuḍanārāyaṇād uttarasyāṃ diśi campākoṭākhya grāme vāgmatyāḥ samīpe

notes: The scribe states he copied it at 16 years of age (ṣoḍaśavarṣeṇa) by the order of his guru (hitājñayā śrīghṛṇino gurur vai). The metrical verse also seems to corruptly spell his name: 'lulokanyugāthaḥ samāli(4)khadvai'.
